definitions.explanation: A weapon that fires projectiles, especially traditional firearms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧{鉄砲|てっぽう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: I play with a water gun.

examples.japanese: {鉄砲|てっぽう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{獲物|えもの}→獲物：08638_emono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撃|う}つ→撃つ：12921_utsu⟧。
examples.english: I shoot prey with a gun.

examples.japanese: {鉄砲|てっぽう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{16|じゅうろく}⟦{世紀|せいき}→世紀：03373_seiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}わった→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧。
examples.english: Guns were introduced to Japan in the 16th century.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子|こ}どもたち→子ども：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧{鉄砲|てっぽう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいた→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。

examples.english: The introduction of firearms greatly changed the way wars were fought in Japan.

notes:
{鉄砲|てっぽう} is the traditional Japanese word for guns/firearms.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧{鉄砲|てっぽう}: water gun
- ⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧{鉄砲|てっぽう}: air gun
- {鉄砲|てっぽう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撃|う}つ→撃つ：12921_utsu⟧: to fire a gun
- {鉄砲|てっぽう}⟦{玉|たま}→玉：02221_tama⟧: bullet

HISTORICAL NOTE:
Guns ({鉄砲|てっぽう}) were introduced to Japan by Portuguese traders in 1543 at Tanegashima.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{銃|じゅう}→銃：10463_juu⟧: gun (more modern term)
- ⟦{拳銃|けんじゅう}→拳銃：16266_kenjuu⟧: handgun, pistol
- ⟦ライフル→ライフル：noentry⟧: rifle
